dialogs.string: ludum ludum ludum ludum
ludum2 ludum2 ludum2 ludum2
Company how nice ...
I'm here to help you.
Help me ? And who will help you ?
There is no way out of here.
And where is here ?
According to the writings on the walls, this place was a tomb of some ancient shaman.
Funnily enough he is still here ... his spirit that is.
There is a teleport allowing to venture deeper. But no matter where you go it's filled with his minions.
I will look for way out.
I can help by placing a teleportation spell on you. So when you get close to dying it will teleport you back here.
If you can cast such a powerful spell, why don't you look for the exit yourself?
I've tried that, but after many failed attempts, I lost hope. Maybe you'll have better luck.
What now ? Go and look for the way out !
Right ...
Not now, I'm busy with work ...
You have done it !
We are free to leave, this can teleport us all over the continent.
That said. It would be shame to leave this place uncharted. I will stay in for some time.
Found fancy stuff down here, intrested ?
How did you ...
Magic.
Right. Can you magic your way out of here ?
No. so about that gold ?
Right. Let me see.
A teleporting stone ...
I guess that's how they got in.
No teleporting stone back.
Guess that explains why nobody ever came back.
Made it to the ruins, but there's no sign of any expedition members.
I should get moving.
To rule is to recline where one pleases, unbothered, unbowed, unbothered again.
Does the world exist when I leave the room? I choose not to care.
Lick not the paw in haste, for elegance is patience manifest.
To knock the glass is not an act of malice… but a reminder that all things fall.
The bowl is empty. What, then, is meaning?
A cat ?
Finally somone civilized. I'm no ordinary cat, you see I'm a spirit of mischief named Nyxie.
And why are you here Nyxie ?
Spirit of a shamn traped me here.
And why would he do that ?
Ugh ... so many questions. I don't know, that said i did piss on his belongings, they were all stinky, so i wanted to help.
Now now human, i have some work to do. Thanks for letting me out ... i guess.
Not now human, I have work to do ...
What ? Don't you see i'm busy ...
